# S5A: absolute-four-hour magnitude ranking

**COMPLETE / TECHNICAL_PASS — NO_INCREMENTAL_RANKING_EVIDENCE.** All four folds completed. Equal-year IC 0.309462 trails CLOCK-C3 0.330254 and S2-C-C3 0.331236, with losses in every year. IC difference versus CLOCK-C3 is −0.020792 (descriptive 95% month-block interval [−0.027676, −0.015673]); top-four retrieval is 0.410463 versus 0.429466. Intraday and overnight IC both decline. Prefix95/99 event recall declines and false-low ranking increases. This is a completed negative ranking result, not a failed implementation.

The full-history linear control has higher IC (0.318193) even though S5-A's own normalized-rank MSE is lower (0.339025 versus 0.341612). The surrogate and common ranking criterion are distinct. S5-A loss decomposes into common-offset squared 0.007536 and centered rank MSE 0.331489; no training centering was introduced. Retain the frozen magnitude-model ranking references; no objective rescue is authorized.

Scores are dimensionless; magnitude MSE/MAE/calibration are N/A. These are repeatedly inspected exploratory years. The intervals condition on fitted/selected models, are not selection-adjusted, and are not independent confirmation. See the combined report for shared protocol, controls, preservation and limitations. The following tables are the saved-score numerical appendix.
